The issue is that `::placeholder` pseudo-element styling is missing. The `color: #FFFFFF` rule only affects typed text, not placeholder text — browsers default placeholder to grey. The login page CSS at line 2228 sets input text to white but never overrides `::placeholder`.Also need to add the same to the global CSS block (line 292) so it applies consistently everywhere:Done.
